race.comment: KING HASS (3) is yet to miss the placings in an excellent record this track and trip which boasts six wins and four placings. Placed last time (26.10) at this track in a Special conditions race, finishing second and beaten 1.3 lengths. With a clean break looks hard to beat. KIWI HANK (4) recorded his best time this course and distance last start, taking a Grade 6 in 25.85 by 3.5 lengths. Rates a leading chance if runs up to latest. OTTO RHODE (7) comes back from a let-up as a top three prospect.
